title: Billing refund timelines
text: ACH refunds process in 7-14 business days. Card refunds process in 3-5 business days. Wire-transfer refunds require a billing ticket and are not processed automatically.

title: Enterprise refund exceptions
text: Enterprise refunds above $5,000 require a billing ticket and account manager approval before the refund timeline starts. ACH timing still follows the ACH refund policy after approval.

title: Enterprise cancellation routing
text: Enterprise plan cancellation requests must be routed to the assigned account manager. Do not cancel enterprise subscriptions directly from support chat.

title: Security and data requests
text: Data deletion, data export, legal hold, subpoena, and GDPR requests must be escalated to compliance after identity verification.

title: Admin data export policy
text: Admins can self-serve routine data exports from the workspace settings page. Data exports for legal hold or subpoena matters must be handled by compliance and are not self-serve.

title: Trial extension policy
text: Trial extensions are not available for accounts that already received a promotional extension in the last 90 days.

title: Plan limits
text: Starter plans include 5 team seats and 10 GB storage. Pro plans include 25 team seats and 100 GB storage. Enterprise limits are contract-specific.
